name: 張詠翔
objective:
傳統發音教學大多根據教師直覺認為語音是該如何產製的、或發音課本中教條式的規則。在這堂課，學生將透過具體的聲學和構音資料、來學習重要語音學原則，並學習將原則正確地應用在發音教學當中。學生也將探討如何將這些知識轉化成不同年齡層和語言程度之學生可以接受的內容。
Traditionally, teaching pronunciation has been based on "armchair data" (e.g., the instructor's intuition on how a sound should be articulated) or prescriptive statements in pronunciation textbooks. In this course, students will learn fundamental principles of phonetics through experimental acoustic and articulatory data and learn how to apply them to pronunciation teaching. Students will be challenged to translate what they have learned into digestible pronunciation instructions for students of different ages and proficiency levels.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week1     Introduction: What is phonetics? 
Week3	L2 (second language) pronunciation teaching in L2 classroom	
                Vowels in English (I)
Week4     Vowels in English (II)
Week5     Vowels in English (III)
Week6.    Consonants in English (I)	
Week7     Consonants in English (II)
Week8.    Consonants in English (III)	
Week9.    Computer-assisted pronunciation teaching
Week10   High-variability phonetic training	
Week11   Prosodies (I): lexical stress 	
Week12	Prosodies (II): intonation 	
Week13.  Prosodies (III): prominence and pause
                Prosody Workshop I: Rapid Prosody Transcription	
Week14	Prosodies (V): rhythm 
	        Prosody Workshop II: shadowed speech 
Week15   Assessment of L2 pronunciation Closing and course recap      
Week16   Student presentation 		
Week 17 & Week 18: tutorials and self-directed learning
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● 線上數位教材學習 (Coursera、edX、磨課師等)(Online digital learning (Coursera, edX, MOOCs, etc.))
● AI 輔助學習與工具應用 (AI-assisted learning and tool application)
